description: Purpose of this region: knowledge about the PWNC Frontend (pwnc/module/content.php) learned from working with it.
content:
This region collects what has been learned about the Frontend — the public website and the live compositing workspace used to edit it.

Belongs here: how editing behaves in practice, how pages and directory entries relate, how the control pad and view modes work, and traps found along the way.

Does not belong here: the templates and placeholders themselves (scope.info_templates, scope.info_placeholders), or the content of the site, which lives in the CMS rather than in memory.
